versions.name: Chimney Park Scout Camp
versions.summary: A historic Adventure West Council camp in the Snowy Range Mountains west of Laramie, Wyoming, set on leased Forest Service land around a small lake and used for weekend unit camping, day events, and outdoor leader training.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Adventure West Council camp-reservation listing and awbsa.org/about, both of which list Chimney Park Scout Camp as a current council property available for weekend camping, day events, and week-long adventures (summer camp operation ceased in the mid-1970s; the property is now managed by a volunteer committee for year-round unit use). Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's own reservation and about pages; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a weekend-camping and training property; features unsurveyed.
